verdict.rationale: Adyen's marketing says platforms can 'control fees' from the Dashboard. The split-payment docs let the platform deduct costs and route funds between a user's balance account and its own liable account, so it can set what sellers pay. Nothing in the pack documents a published buy rate from Adyen or interchange-level cost breakdowns for managing the spread. Missing for 10: documented buy-rate/pricing model (e.g. interchange++), explicit sell-rate/fee configuration docs, interchange-level cost visibility in reports, independent corroboration.
